content: macOS menu bar app refresh patterns: (1) coarse polling via Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval:) on main runloop (already used in this app at 900s); (2) countdown/elapsed-marker UI via a minute-granularity ticker - either SwiftUI TimelineView(.everyMinute) (macOS 12+) for display-only, or an @Observable async clock that sleeps until the next minute boundary (Task.sleep), which is testable and drives multiple views (pattern used by withLinda/CodexPlusBar AppMinuteClock); (3) reset-boundary refresh: schedule a one-shot refresh shortly after the soonest reset_at, or compute timeUntilReset on each poll and trigger an extra fetch when it falls inside the poll interval. Menu bar apps run indefinitely so plain Timer/Task.sleep is fine; no BGTaskScheduler needed.
